description_en: Queries the CIDR blocks of a transit router
description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterCidr接口查询转发路由器下CIDR地址段的信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-cidr --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-4260000 --transit-router-id tr-p0w3x8c9em72a40nw0000 --transit-router-cidr-id cidr-0zv0q9crqpntzz0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouterCidr

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transit router
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CIDR block
parameters.name: transit_router_cidr_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the transit router.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether only to precheck the API request. Valid values:

true: prechecks the request but does not query the CIDR block. The system checks the required parameters, the request format, and the service limits. If the request fails the check, an error message is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. After the request passes the check, the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会查询转发路由器已添加的地址段。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接查询转发路由器下已添加的地址段
parameters.name: dry_run
